description: This Java source file defines the SecureWebServer class, which implements a simple HTTPS server using Android's SSL APIs. The server loads a PKCS12 key store, initializes SSL context, and serves a basic HTML page with an embedded Base64-encoded image over secure connections. It runs on port 8080 and handles incoming SSL socket connections, responding with a static HTML page including the embedded image.

classes.name: SecureWebServer
classes.description: Class implementing a basic SSL/TLS web server for Android, capable of serving a static HTML page with embedded image over HTTPS.

methods.name: SecureWebServer
methods.description: Constructor initializing SSL context and loading keystore, preparing the server for listening.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the server in a new thread, listening on port 8080, and handling incoming SSL socket connections.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the server by closing the server socket and halting the listening loop.

methods.name: createBase64Image
methods.description: Reads an image from assets and encodes it into a Base64 string for embedding in HTML.
